title: The Quilt Squares in Order
youtube_title: The Quilt Squares in Order | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Two careful pairs of hands can do what one rush cannot.
summary: At a harbor dock where baskets are passed up, a quilt squares that made a picture only in the right order will go wrong if one person rushes. Delia and Willa split it into two slow jobs, while Uncle Idris only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
